frontText: Navy 67 centered on a yellow door card. Dashed cut-line border. No other printed text.

items.title: South America
items.placementTarget: Board, over South America. Graticule shows 20°S, 60°W (northeast and again near the southeast coast), and 80°W.

cities.name: Bogotá
cities.graticule: Northwest of the continent, west of the printed 60°W label in the dark sea to the northeast. Population 2 square is east of the disc. The name is printed with an accent: Bogotá.

cities.name: Lima
cities.graticule: West coast, just north of the printed 20°S line. Population 1 square is east of the disc. No sea lane touches the disc.

cities.name: Santiago
cities.graticule: South of 20°S, inland from the west coast and west of the meridian that falls between Santiago and Buenos Aires. Population 1 square is in the sea west of the disc.

cities.name: Buenos Aires
cities.graticule: East coast, east of the meridian printed between it and Santiago (the 60°W label is at the bottom near this coast). Population 2 square is west of the disc.

printedRoutes.notes: A blue sea lane leaves the east side of the Buenos Aires disc and exits the right edge. São Paulo is the starting-board port in that direction; its name is not printed on this sticker. Lima has no printed lane.

specialAreas.name: northern void
specialAreas.notes: The sea north and northeast of the continent, including the area around the printed 60°W label, is the dark surround. It is not a red region line.

mechanics.notes: All four cities are yellow. None are infested. Bogotá is inland population 2. Lima is a port at population 1. Santiago is inland population 1. Buenos Aires is a port at population 2. No recon box and no red region line.

summary: South America. All four cities are yellow and not infested. Bogotá inland 2, Lima port 1, Santiago inland 1, Buenos Aires port 2. A sea lane leaves Buenos Aires off the east edge toward São Paulo. No recon box and no red region line.
